description: Create Next.js error pages and enhanced user experience for error handling. This includes not-found.tsx, error.tsx, and improved error UI components. Current codebase has error-display.tsx but needs Next.js-specific error pages and better error recovery flows for the multi-role exam management system.
steps: Create src/app/not-found.tsx (Next.js 404 page) with navigation back to appropriate dashboard based on user role and helpful messaging
Create src/app/error.tsx (Next.js error page) for unhandled errors with retry functionality and role-aware navigation
Enhance existing src/components/ui/error-display.tsx with additional error types (network, permission, authentication) and better recovery actions
Create src/app/unauthorized/error.tsx for 403 errors with clear messaging and appropriate actions for each role (admin, faculty, student, staff, hod)
Add error page templates for common scenarios: network errors, server errors, authentication failures
Update error pages to integrate with existing Tailwind design system and match current UI patterns found in dashboard components
acceptance_criteria: 404 errors show user-friendly page with navigation appropriate to user's role
Unhandled Next.js errors show custom error page with retry and recovery options
Error pages maintain consistent design with existing ExamGuard UI using Tailwind classes
Users can navigate back to working areas of the app from any error page
Error pages provide contextual help based on user role (admin vs faculty vs student vs staff vs hod)
verification: npm run build successfully compiles new error pages
Manual testing: Navigate to non-existent route, verify custom 404 page shows
Manual testing: Simulate server errors, verify custom error page displays with retry options
Verify error pages work correctly for all user roles by testing different dashboard routes
